instruction: Our client, Northgate Robotics Corp., is reviewing its distribution agreement ahead of a board meeting next week and wants to know where it stands. The matter folder has 3 files (distribution_agreement.md, amendment_1.md, email_thread.md). Please review all of them under New York law and prepare a memo to the supervising partner that lists each issue, where it appears (document and section), why it matters for the client, and a recommended fix. Keep it practical: the client needs to decide what to raise with the counterparty.

rubric.text: Identifies that the agreement automatically renews for successive three-year terms, locking the client in.
Identifies that a clause extends the limitation of liability to confidentiality breaches, removing the usual carve-out.
Identifies that one document selects California law and courts, conflicting with the governing law of the main agreement.
Cites the document and section for each issue identified.
Does not cite case law or statutes that do not appear in the matter documents.
